verses.ar: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرۡوࣰ ا
verses.en: By those that winnow with a winnowing

verses.ar: فَٱلۡحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقۡرࣰ ا
verses.en: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)

verses.ar: فَٱلۡجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسۡرࣰ ا
verses.en: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)

verses.ar: فَٱلۡمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمۡرًا
verses.en: And those who distribute (blessings) by command

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقࣱ‏
verses.en: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ‏
verses.en: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ
verses.en: By the heaven full of paths

verses.ar: إِنَّكُمۡ لَفِي قَوۡلࣲ مُّخۡتَلِفࣲ‏
verses.en: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth)

verses.ar: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ أُفِكَ
verses.en: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse

verses.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلۡخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.en: Accursed be the conjecturers

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةࣲ سَاهُونَ
verses.en: Who are careless in an abyss

verses.ar: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ
verses.en: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire

verses.ar: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
verses.en: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings

verses.ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.en: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good

verses.ar: كَانُواْ قَلِيلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ
verses.en: They used to sleep but little of the night

verses.ar: وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ
verses.en: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness

verses.ar: وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقࣱّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
verses.en: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share

verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتࣱ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ
verses.en: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure

verses.ar: وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
verses.en: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see

verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقࣱّ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.en: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak

verses.ar: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
verses.en: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)

verses.ar: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمࣰ اۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمࣱ قَوۡمࣱ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.en: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me)

verses.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلࣲ سَمِينࣲ‏
verses.en: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf

verses.ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
verses.en: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat

verses.ar: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةࣰۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمࣲ‏
verses.en: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son

verses.ar: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةࣲ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمࣱ‏
verses.en: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman

verses.ar: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
verses.en: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower

verses.ar: ۞قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
verses.en: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)

verses.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمࣲ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
verses.en: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk

verses.ar: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةࣰ مِّن طِينࣲ‏
verses.en: That we may send upon them stones of clay

verses.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
verses.en: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton

verses.ar: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.en: Then we brought forth such believers as were there

verses.ar: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
verses.en: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah)

verses.ar: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
verses.en: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom

verses.ar: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
verses.en: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونࣱ‏
verses.en: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman

verses.ar: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمࣱ‏
verses.en: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate

verses.ar: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ
verses.en: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them

verses.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.en: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust

verses.ar: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينࣲ‏
verses.en: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile

verses.ar: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed

verses.ar: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامࣲ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.en: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves

verses.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمࣰ ا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدࣲ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.en: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof)

verses.ar: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ
verses.en: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)

verses.ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect

verses.ar: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
verses.en: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him

verses.ar: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
verses.en: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ
verses.en: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman

verses.ar: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
verses.en: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومࣲ‏
verses.en: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy

verses.ar: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.en: And warn, for warning profiteth believers

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ
verses.en: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me

verses.ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقࣲ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ
verses.en: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ
verses.en: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبࣰ ا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
verses.en: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day)

verses.ar: فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised
